description: An architectural mapping that assigns each business domain to either 'use cache' (shared cache with cacheLife and tags) or dynamic <Suspense> streaming based on scope and consistency.
Using revalidateTag(tag, 'max') inside Route Handlers triggered by external CMS or supplier webhooks so readers never block on cold cache rebuilds.
Using updateTag(tag) inside Server Actions when an authenticated seller or author mutates cached data and must immediately observe their updated state.
Keeping live inventory locks, cart holds, and per-user session checks outside 'use cache' and streaming them inside <Suspense> boundaries.
